report_title: EY Four Trends Redefining Cash Management
executive_summary: This EY report, based on the 'Voice of the Treasurer' research involving over 1,800 survey responses and 21 CFO/treasurer interviews, identifies four key trends reshaping cash management. It highlights a critical shift from transaction-oriented products to strategic, data-driven services, driven by advancements in AI, machine learning, and blockchain. The report concludes that banks must embrace these innovations to enrich their value propositions, expand service portfolios, and strengthen client relationships, thereby repositioning finance teams as strategic advisors to the business.
key_stats: 73% of survey respondents say digitizing treasury functions is a challenge (p.7)
44% of respondents will use managed services from banks to address digitization challenges (p.7)
90% of CFOs and treasurers are comfortable using an AI financial advisor that makes recommendations (p.12)
92% of corporate treasurers are comfortable using sector-specific platforms tailored to their industry's unique needs (p.17)
71% of corporate treasurers say there is a lack of suitable sector-centric tools to address their unique financial situation (p.17)
>75% of institutional investors expect to increase their allocations to digital assets in 2025 (p.21)

themes.name: Treasury automation evolves from process efficiency to business intelligence
themes.description: This trend describes the progression of treasury automation beyond basic process efficiency to leveraging AI-powered tools for business intelligence. It encompasses real-time liquidity management, virtual account structures, automated intercompany movements, and advanced forecasting models. The goal is to provide actionable insights and improve short-term investment decisions, with clients seeking configurable automation that maintains user control.
themes.positioning_rationale: CMIplus's existing EBICS, H2H, and SWIFT channels support process efficiency. The planned AI Cash Flow Forecasting for Q4/2026 directly aligns with the shift towards business intelligence, though broader virtual account management capabilities could enhance this further.
themes.key_stat: 73% of survey respondents say digitizing treasury functions is a challenge (p.7)

themes.name: Data-driven services redefine the role of banks in corporate cash management
themes.description: Banks are moving from being mere transaction processors to strategic advisors by integrating high-value internal and external data. This includes macroeconomic indicators, supply chain disruptions, and sector benchmarks, to deliver predictive insights and proactive alerts. The aim is to provide clear, actionable recommendations tailored to clients' specific operational needs and business objectives.
themes.positioning_rationale: While AI Cash Flow Forecasting is a step, CMIplus's current roadmap doesn't explicitly detail the integration of diverse external data sources or the provision of comprehensive, proactive advisory services. This deeper strategic role requires significant investment in analytics and data aggregation beyond basic forecasting.
themes.key_stat: 90% of CFOs and treasurers are comfortable using an AI financial advisor that makes recommendations in response to financial issues (p.12)

themes.name: Industry-specific solutions become the standard in corporate banking
themes.description: Clients increasingly expect cash management services tailored to their industry's unique dynamics, rather than generic financial products. This demands verticalized solutions, industry-specific playbooks, and embedded human expertise to address sector-specific risk triggers, regulatory workflows, and payment needs. Banks that offer such specialized knowledge gain a significant competitive advantage.
themes.positioning_rationale: CMIplus's strengths currently lie in broad CEE network coverage and multi-currency support, which are horizontal offerings. There is no explicit mention of developing or offering industry-specific cash management solutions or advisory services, indicating a gap in meeting this growing client expectation.
themes.key_stat: 92% of corporate treasurers are comfortable using sector-specific platforms tailored to their industry's unique needs (p.17)

themes.name: Blockchain market infrastructure creates new methods of value exchange – and growth opportunities for banks
themes.description: The increasing adoption of digital assets like stablecoins and tokenized deposits, coupled with regulatory clarity, presents new opportunities and threats. Banks can facilitate digital asset investments, issue stablecoins, and leverage tokenization to streamline settlement, collateralization, and cross-border payments. This trend also opens avenues for banks to serve digital-native clients in the cryptocurrency sector.
themes.positioning_rationale: The CMIplus context does not indicate any current initiatives or plans related to blockchain, digital assets, stablecoins, or tokenization. This area represents a significant emerging trend that CMIplus has yet to address, potentially missing future growth opportunities.
themes.key_stat: >75% of institutional investors expect to increase their allocations to digital assets in 2025 (p.21)

key_actions.action: Accelerate the development and integration of AI-powered business intelligence tools, specifically focusing on actionable recommendations and predictive insights beyond basic cash flow forecasting.
key_actions.rationale: This will move CMIplus beyond process efficiency to strategic intelligence, meeting client demand for proactive financial advice. It will also differentiate CMIplus from competitors offering only basic forecasting.

key_actions.action: Initiate a strategic review to identify key CEE industries for which CMIplus can develop tailored, verticalized cash management solutions and advisory services.
key_actions.rationale: Client demand for industry-specific solutions is very high, and CMIplus currently lacks this focus. This is crucial for strengthening client relationships and competitive differentiation in the CEE market.
key_actions.timeline: Q3 2026 (start market analysis and internal capability assessment)

key_actions.action: Enhance Open API capabilities to support broader data integration (internal and external) and enable clients to customize self-service cash management solutions.
key_actions.rationale: The report emphasizes API connectivity for customization and data-driven services. Aligning the UNIFI format expected in Q3/2026 with these broader data integration goals is critical for client empowerment.
key_actions.timeline: Q3 2026 (align UNIFI format with data integration goals)

key_actions.action: Explore partnerships or pilot programs for digital assets, stablecoins, and tokenization to understand their potential impact on cash management processes and future growth opportunities.
key_actions.rationale: This is an emerging but significant trend that could redefine value exchange. Early exploration is vital to avoid being left behind as regulatory clarity increases and market adoption grows.
key_actions.timeline: Q4 2026 (initial feasibility study and partner identification)

competitive_implications: RBI's CEE network coverage and EBICS expertise are strong foundational assets. However, competitors like Citi and Deutsche Bank are likely making significant investments in data-driven services and potentially blockchain. CMIplus's current lack of explicit industry-specific solutions and digital asset offerings could put RBI at a disadvantage if these trends accelerate rapidly, necessitating swift strategic action to maintain and grow market share.

executive_summary: The 2025 McKinsey Global Payments Report dissects the evolving global payments ecosystem, highlighting the rise of diverse payment rails, the impact of digital assets, and the transformative power of AI. It concludes that the industry is at a turning point, moving towards fragmented systems and contested outcomes rather than universal efficiency. Success will hinge on agility, innovation, and trust, with a strong emphasis on interoperability and adapting to new economic and technological realities. The report provides a roadmap for players to navigate this complex landscape through strategic investments and operational shifts.
key_stats: Global payments revenue reached $2.5 trillion in 2024, projected to grow to $3.0 trillion by 2029.
Payments industry generated an average 18.9% return on equity in 2024.
Global payments revenue growth slowed to 4% in 2024, a notable drop from 12% in 2023.
Interest income constituted 46% of total payments revenues in 2024.
Cash usage declined to 46% of worldwide payments in 2024 (from 50% in 2023).
Digital wallets now account for approximately 30% of global point-of-sale volume.
Stablecoin issuance doubled since early 2024, with daily transaction volumes around $30 billion.

themes.name: Payments Fragmentation & Regionalization
themes.description: The global payments ecosystem is shifting from a pursuit of universal efficiency to a competition among diverse market systems. Geopolitical events and technological progress are fueling increased regionalization and the rise of local payment systems, leading to a more fragmented landscape. This trend presents two possible outcomes: a multirail ecosystem with global passkeys or escalated fragmentation with declining worldwide standards.
themes.positioning_rationale: RBI's strong CEE network coverage, EBICS expertise, and multi-currency support position CMIplus well within a regionalizing payments landscape. Its ability to handle native formats per country aligns with the report's emphasis on diverse regional standards and local schemes.
themes.key_stat: The growing divergence in payments reflects the evolution of the broader financial system into a mosaic of regions with different standards, timelines, currencies, and trust anchors.

themes.name: Digital Assets & Programmable Money
themes.description: Stablecoins and tokenized money are gaining traction, driven by increasing regulatory clarity, advancing technological infrastructure, and growing demand for real-world applications. These assets offer potential for instant cross-border payments, intraday returns, and programmable features. However, they also introduce risks related to regulatory consistency, trust, and potential disruption to traditional deposit funding models.
themes.positioning_rationale: CMIplus currently lacks explicit initiatives or capabilities related to stablecoins or tokenized money, which are identified as increasingly important parts of the financial system. This emerging area, with its potential for real-time cross-border payments and programmable features, represents a significant gap in CMIplus's offering.
themes.key_stat: Stablecoin issuance has doubled since early 2024—but its role in the broader global payments landscape remains limited. With daily transaction volumes around $30 billion...

themes.name: AI's Transformative Impact & Agentic Commerce
themes.description: Artificial Intelligence is reshaping payments through enhanced efficiency in transaction processing, software engineering, fraud detection, and risk management. The rise of 'agentic AI' is particularly transformative, enabling AI agents to operate independently and transact on humans' behalf. This creates new battlegrounds for control over the 'edge' of commerce and requires rethinking customer engagement.
themes.positioning_rationale: CMIplus has AI Cash Flow Forecasting planned for Q4 2026, indicating an awareness and initial step towards AI adoption. However, the report highlights broader applications in fraud detection, reconciliation, and agentic commerce where CMIplus needs to expand its AI strategy to remain competitive.
themes.key_stat: 10 percent of consumers use Al to start their online shopping journey, and 20 percent would be comfortable asking Al to make a purchase on their behalf.

themes.name: Evolution of Payment Rails & Monetization
themes.description: There's a global decline in cash usage and a rapid shift towards lower-cost payment options like account-to-account (A2A) transfers and digital wallets. This evolution puts pressure on traditional fee-based revenue models, particularly within card-based ecosystems. New economic and fee models are expected to emerge as transaction volumes shift to these modern rails.
themes.positioning_rationale: CMIplus supports modern payment formats like ISO 20022 and has implemented Verification of Payee (VoP), indicating a move towards modern rails. However, explicit integration with popular regional digital wallets for corporate payments is not mentioned, which is a growing trend in the market.
themes.key_stat: Cash usage continues to decline globally, now accounting for 46 percent of worldwide payments... digital wallets... account for approximately 30 percent of global point-of-sale volume...

themes.name: Interoperability & Ecosystems
themes.description: In a fragmented and multirail world, interoperability is no longer a differentiator but a fundamental requirement. Players need adaptive infrastructure that can bridge asset types, jurisdictions, and compliance regimes in real time. Success hinges on becoming a foundational layer within broader ecosystems, fostering partnerships, and designing for intelligent simplicity.
themes.positioning_rationale: CMIplus's Open API scaling initiative, support for various channels (EBICS, H2H, SWIFT), and multi-currency capabilities demonstrate a commitment to interoperability. Scaling the UNIFI format by Q3 2026 is a key step in aligning with the need for adaptive infrastructure and ecosystem play.
themes.key_stat: Cross-border and multirail transactions will define any foreseeable future scenario. The ability to bridge asset types, jurisdictions, and compliance regimes in real time will no longer be a differentiator.

key_actions.action: Initiate a strategic review and pilot program for stablecoin and tokenized money integration for corporate payments.
key_actions.rationale: This is a significant emerging area with the potential to disrupt traditional cross-border payments and liquidity management. Early exploration is crucial to avoid being left behind by competitors and to capture new value streams.

key_actions.action: Expand AI strategy beyond cash flow forecasting to include fraud detection, reconciliation automation, and agentic commerce enablement.
key_actions.rationale: AI is critical for enhancing efficiency, security, and customer experience across the payments value chain. Broadening AI application will drive significant productivity gains and competitive advantage.

key_actions.action: Proactively integrate CMIplus with leading regional digital wallets and A2A payment schemes across CEE markets.
key_actions.rationale: The shift to lower-cost A2A and digital wallets is accelerating, particularly in retail checkouts. Integrating these options will meet evolving customer preferences and maintain CMIplus's relevance in the payment ecosystem.

key_actions.action: Accelerate the Open API scaling initiative, prioritizing UNIFI format adoption and exploring partnerships for broader ecosystem integration.
key_actions.rationale: Interoperability is no longer a differentiator but a necessity in a multirail environment. A robust API strategy and ecosystem play are vital for seamless integration and future growth.

competitive_implications: RBI's CEE network coverage and EBICS expertise provide a strong competitive advantage in a regionalizing payments landscape, aligning with the report's fragmentation theme. However, lagging in digital assets and broader AI adoption could allow global competitors like Citi or Deutsche Bank, with larger R&D budgets, to gain ground in innovative payment solutions, potentially eroding RBI's market share in advanced corporate offerings. Proactive investment in these emerging areas is crucial to maintain leadership and prevent disintermediation.

executive_summary: The "Journeys to Treasury 2025/26" report, a 10th-anniversary edition, synthesizes insights from an EACT survey, corporate case studies, and expert roundtables to chart the evolution of treasury. It highlights a renewed focus on fundamental competencies like cash flow forecasting, alongside the accelerating impact of digital transformation. Key themes include the future of payments (Instant Payments, VoP, ISO 20022), the rise of virtual accounts for real-time liquidity, and the pragmatic adoption of AI in treasury operations. The report underscores the need for treasurers to master basics while preparing for complex, interconnected, and strategically demanding frontiers.
key_stats: 30.5% of treasurers prioritize cash flow forecasting the most (EACT Treasury Survey 2025).
27.3% of treasurers cite inaccurate forecasting as a leading challenge for centralisation.
38.5% of respondents cite difficulties in standardising processes as their most significant obstacle to centralisation.
27.6% of treasurers list fraud prevention as a priority.
17% of corporates now use virtual accounts primarily for reconciling incoming payments (PwC 2025 Global Treasury Survey).
20% of respondents have already implemented real-time payments, and another 34% plan to do so soon (PwC survey).
Reviewing or replacing treasury technology infrastructure is the third-highest priority (EACT Treasury Survey 2025).

themes.name: Cash Flow Forecasting & Liquidity Visibility
themes.description: Cash flow forecasting has risen to the top of treasurers' priorities, driven by macroeconomic volatility and the need for reliable short-term and rolling forecasts. Accurate visibility underpins working capital optimization and funding strategies, yet many models still rely on semi-manual processes, making inaccurate forecasting a leading challenge for centralisation. The report emphasizes that real-time information is becoming a necessity, not a luxury.
themes.positioning_rationale: CMIplus has AI Cash Flow Forecasting planned for Q4/2026, which directly addresses the report's call for advanced forecasting tools. However, the current state of corporate forecasting highlighted in the report suggests a strong, immediate need for robust solutions that CMIplus is still developing.
themes.key_stat: 30.5% of treasurers prioritize cash flow forecasting the most.

themes.name: Digital Transformation & Automation
themes.description: Treasurers are focusing on fundamentals: systems, data, and skills as the building blocks for change. Legacy technology and fragmented architecture are significant obstacles to digitisation, despite years of investment. Automation is crucial for achieving near-total straight-through processing, enhancing compliance, and enabling strategic decision-making, moving beyond quick fixes to core infrastructure improvements.
themes.positioning_rationale: CMIplus offers a strong foundation with various channels (EBICS v2.5 + v3, H2H, SWIFT, Web, Mobile, Open API) and ISO 20022 support. The renewed focus on eBAM (Account Maintenance) aligns with the report's emphasis on fixing core infrastructure before chasing the next wave of innovation.
themes.key_stat: Reviewing or replacing treasury technology infrastructure is the third-highest priority.

themes.name: Payments Modernization (Instant Payments, VoP, ISO 20022)
themes.description: The payments landscape is undergoing significant transformation due to the EU Instant Payments Regulation, Verification of Payee (VoP), and ISO 20022 migration. These changes offer opportunities for real-time liquidity management and fraud reduction but also introduce complexities related to fraud risks, integration, and the need for standardised data. Corporates must prepare for a more complex and interconnected payment environment.
themes.positioning_rationale: CMIplus is already live with VoP since October 2025 and fully compliant on its web channel, positioning it ahead of the regulatory curve. Its support for ISO 20022 pain.001 also demonstrates readiness for the evolving messaging standards.
themes.key_stat: VoP (Verification of Payee) is launching in October 2025.

themes.name: Virtual Accounts & Real-Time Liquidity
themes.description: Virtual accounts are gaining traction as a mainstream treasury tool, offering instant visibility, streamlined reconciliation, and enhanced financial insights. They enable treasurers to reduce physical accounts, segregate flows, and support advanced cash management structures like POBO/COBO. The goal is continuous, on-demand visibility into every account and transaction, moving beyond end-of-day snapshots.
themes.positioning_rationale: While CMIplus offers multi-currency support, the report highlights virtual accounts as a key enabler for real-time liquidity. CMIplus needs to ensure its virtual account offering is robust and integrated to fully capitalize on this growing demand and align with industry best practices.
themes.key_stat: 17% of corporates now use virtual accounts primarily for reconciling incoming payments.

themes.name: AI in Treasury Operations
themes.description: AI is transitioning from hype to practical application in treasury, with use cases emerging in cash flow forecasting, compliance, and workflow automation. Successful adoption requires good data, a pragmatic step-by-step approach, and combining AI tools with human judgment. AI is seen as an enabler for strategic thinking, helping treasurers move from scorekeeper to strategic partner.
themes.positioning_rationale: CMIplus has AI Cash Flow Forecasting planned for Q4/2026, which aligns with the report's focus on practical AI applications in forecasting. This positions RBI to meet evolving client expectations for intelligent automation, but execution is key.
themes.key_stat: Lower ranking of AI and blockchain suggests treasurers are still in the early stages of adopting these more advanced tools.

themes.name: Regulatory Compliance & Fraud Prevention
themes.description: Treasurers face increasing pressure from regulatory obligations (e.g., ESG reporting, ISO 20022, PSD3) and a surge in cyber risk and fraud threats. Strong governance, automated controls, and real-time monitoring are critical for fraud prevention. VoP is a key initiative to strengthen security and trust in payments, requiring proactive engagement from corporates, banks, and regulators.
themes.positioning_rationale: CMIplus's early and fully compliant implementation of VoP on its web channel demonstrates a proactive approach to a critical regulatory and fraud prevention priority. This positions RBI as a secure and compliant partner in the evolving payment landscape.
themes.key_stat: 27.6% of treasurers list fraud prevention as a priority.

key_actions.action: Accelerate AI Cash Flow Forecasting Development and Rollout
key_actions.rationale: Cash flow forecasting is the top priority for treasurers, and AI is a critical enabler for accuracy and strategic insight. Expediting this will directly address a core client pain point and enhance CMIplus's competitive offering.
key_actions.timeline: Q4 2026 (current plan, evaluate for earlier MVP)

key_actions.action: Develop and Market a Comprehensive Virtual Account Solution
key_actions.rationale: Virtual accounts are becoming mainstream for real-time liquidity and reconciliation. CMIplus needs a robust, integrated offering beyond basic multi-currency to meet growing demand and compete effectively.

key_actions.action: Proactively Educate Clients on VoP Best Practices and Benefits
key_actions.rationale: CMIplus is ahead on VoP compliance, but corporates are confused about practical implementation. Providing clear guidance and support can strengthen client trust and drive adoption of RBI's advanced capabilities.

key_actions.action: Scale Open API with UNIFI Format for Real-Time Data & Connectivity
key_actions.rationale: Real-time visibility and seamless data integration are essential for modern treasury. Scaling Open API with the UNIFI format will enable advanced use cases and solidify CMIplus as a future-proof platform.

competitive_implications: RBI's strong CEE network coverage, EBICS expertise, and early implementation of VoP provide a strong competitive advantage against regional and global players like UniCredit and Erste Bank. However, the report indicates that competitors are also heavily investing in digital transformation, AI, and real-time liquidity solutions. RBI must continue to accelerate its AI, virtual account, and Open API initiatives to maintain its leadership position and avoid falling behind in these rapidly evolving areas.

executive_summary: The 2025 PwC Global Treasury Survey, drawing insights from 350 treasurers globally, highlights the treasury function's evolution into a strategic, data-driven partner crucial for enterprise value creation. It details how treasurers are navigating economic volatility, regulatory shifts, and trade tensions by adopting connected operating models. Key conclusions point to the increasing importance of cash efficiency, sophisticated financial risk management, leveraging AI, optimizing technology ecosystems with APIs, and exploring managed services to enhance agility and resilience.
key_stats: Over 70% of treasurers prioritize real-time cash visibility and liquidity management to unlock trapped cash and drive working capital efficiency.
Only 30% of organizations fully realize the potential of their existing Treasury Management Systems, indicating significant underutilization and a need for ecosystem integration.
More than 60% of leading treasury organizations are investing in modular technology ecosystems enabled by APIs for greater flexibility and scalability.
Approximately 55% of treasury functions plan to implement AI-enhanced forecasting capabilities within the next 18-24 months to improve decision-making.
Around 45% of treasurers are exploring or adopting managed services models to optimize operations, reduce costs, and focus internal resources strategically.
80% of treasurers view their role as increasingly strategic, shifting from a transactional custodian to a proactive value architect and financial strategist.

themes.name: Strategic Evolution of Treasury
themes.description: The report emphasizes treasury's transformation from a back-office function to a strategic partner that delivers actionable insights and shapes financial strategy. Treasurers are expected to proactively steer organizations through uncertainty and contribute directly to enterprise value creation, moving beyond mere operational control.
themes.positioning_rationale: CMIplus's comprehensive capabilities, including multi-currency support and planned AI Cash Flow Forecasting, empower treasurers with the data and tools needed for strategic decision-making. This aligns with the report's vision of treasury as a strategic value architect.
themes.key_stat: 80% of treasurers view their role as increasingly strategic, shifting from transactional custodian to value architect.

themes.name: Enhanced Cash Efficiency & Liquidity Management
themes.description: Treasury teams face escalating demands for superior cash visibility, cost efficiency, and real-time liquidity management. The survey highlights the adoption of advanced tools like in-house banks, real-time liquidity solutions, and centralized payment models to optimize working capital and unlock trapped cash.
themes.positioning_rationale: CMIplus's robust CEE network, multi-currency capabilities, and diverse channels (EBICS, H2H, SWIFT) provide a strong foundation for real-time cash visibility. The live VoP and planned AI Cash Flow Forecasting further enhance its ability to drive efficiency and liquidity.
themes.key_stat: Over 70% of treasurers prioritize real-time cash visibility and liquidity management to unlock trapped cash and drive working capital efficiency.

themes.name: Adoption of AI in Treasury
themes.description: AI is identified as a critical technology for future treasury, particularly for enhancing forecasting accuracy and enabling faster, more informed decisions. Its application extends to improving risk management and operational efficiency in complex and volatile financial landscapes.
themes.positioning_rationale: CMIplus's 'AI Cash Flow Forecasting' planned for Q4/2026 directly addresses this emerging trend. This proactive initiative positions RBI to meet future client demands for advanced analytical capabilities, aligning with the survey's findings.
themes.key_stat: Approximately 55% of treasury functions plan to implement AI-enhanced forecasting capabilities within the next 18-24 months to improve decision-making.

themes.name: Modular Treasury Technology Ecosystems & APIs
themes.description: The report stresses that while most organizations have a Treasury Management System (TMS), many fail to fully leverage its potential. The trend is towards investing in modular technology ecosystems, heavily reliant on Application Programming Interfaces (APIs), to achieve flexibility, scalability, and optimize value.
themes.positioning_rationale: CMIplus demonstrates strong alignment with this trend through its advanced EBICS v2.5/v3 support, H2H, SWIFT, and particularly its 'Open API: scaling initiative, UNIFI format expected Q3/2026'. This focus on open, integrated architecture positions CMIplus as a leader.
themes.key_stat: More than 60% of leading treasury organizations are investing in modular technology ecosystems enabled by APIs for greater flexibility and scalability.

themes.name: Leveraging Managed Services
themes.description: Managed services models are gaining traction as a strategy for treasury organizations to achieve greater flexibility, scale operations efficiently, and optimize value. This approach allows companies to outsource certain operational tasks, freeing internal resources for more strategic activities.
themes.positioning_rationale: CMIplus is a platform, not a managed service offering that directly handles treasury operations for clients. While it provides the tools, RBI does not explicitly offer a 'managed service' wrapper for treasury, representing a potential gap in addressing this market trend.
themes.key_stat: Around 45% of treasurers are exploring or adopting managed services models to optimize operations, reduce costs, and focus internal resources strategically.

themes.name: Advanced Financial Risk Management
themes.description: The volatile macroeconomic environment, marked by inflation, FX fluctuations, and trade tensions, necessitates sophisticated risk management frameworks. Treasurers are increasing investments in scenario modeling and expanding exposure visibility across global operations to mitigate financial risks effectively.
themes.positioning_rationale: CMIplus's multi-currency support and extensive CEE network provide the essential data and infrastructure for clients to build robust risk management frameworks. While CMIplus doesn't offer direct scenario modeling, it facilitates the data aggregation critical for such analyses.
themes.key_stat: Over 65% of treasurers are increasing investment in scenario modeling and expanded exposure visibility to manage macroeconomic risks.

key_actions.action: Accelerate Open API Development and UNIFI Adoption
key_actions.rationale: The report strongly emphasizes modular ecosystems and APIs for flexibility and scalability. Expediting the UNIFI format by Q3/2026 and expanding API capabilities will solidify CMIplus's 'AHEAD' positioning and meet evolving client demands for seamless integration.

The survey highlights a significant trend towards managed services for operational optimization. Investigating how RBI/CMIplus could offer a 'Treasury-as-a-Service' layer, leveraging the platform, could open new revenue streams and address a market gap.

key_actions.action: Integrate eBAM with Broader Digital Account Management
key_actions.rationale: Resuming focus on eBAM (acmt.015, acmt.017) aligns with the need for operational efficiency and reducing manual effort. Integrating this with other digital account maintenance features can enhance the strategic value and user experience of the platform.

key_actions.action: Enhance AI Cash Flow Forecasting with Scenario Planning & Risk Analytics
key_actions.rationale: While AI Cash Flow Forecasting is planned, integrating scenario modeling capabilities and deeper risk analytics would directly address the report's emphasis on sophisticated risk management and proactive financial steering, further empowering strategic treasurers.

competitive_implications: This report reinforces RBI's strong position in CEE, particularly with its EBICS expertise and multi-currency support, which are critical for cash efficiency and risk management. Competitors like UniCredit and Erste will undoubtedly also focus on AI and APIs, making CMIplus's accelerated development in these areas crucial to maintain its 'AHEAD' status. The emergence of managed services as a key trend presents both a competitive threat and a significant opportunity for RBI to differentiate by exploring new service models.
